core_obligations: Part (2) and (1)(a)=>(1)(b): definitional, using that x: U -> X smooth surjective is an object of the lisse-etale site (proof lines 3156-3161).

(1)(b)=>(1)(a): W = U x_X V with p flat and q smooth surjective (faithful on qc modules); the fbc property gives p^*(F|_{U_etale}) = q^*(F|_{V_etale}); since F|_{U_etale} = 0 we get F|_{V_etale} = 0 (proof lines 3162-3178).
proof_roadmap: Lisse-etale converse via the cartesian diagram and fbc.
difficulty_reason: The flat-fppf equivalence is definition-level because every flat point lies in the site. The lisse-etale direction (1)(b)=>(1)(a) uses the smooth presentation U -> X, the cartesian diagram with W = U x_X V, flatness of p and smooth-surjectivity (faithfulness) of q, and the fbc isomorphism p^*(F|_U) = q^*(F|_V) to force F|_{V_etale} = 0.
